name: Rita Segato
shortBio: Argentine-Brazilian feminist anthropologist and philosopher who theorized the "pedagogy of cruelty" and showed how colonial modernity transformed low-intensity Indigenous gender dualities into lethal patriarchy.
centralQuestion: Why is contemporary violence against women not private pathology, but an expressive mandate of patriarchal sovereignty and colonial-capitalist pedagogy of cruelty?

keyWorks.title: Las estructuras elementales de la violencia
keyWorks.description: Establishes the structural grammar of patriarchal violence as a vertical and horizontal mandate of masculine brotherhood.

keyWorks.title: La guerra contra las mujeres
keyWorks.description: Theorizes feminicide and the "pedagogy of cruelty" as core instruments of contemporary extractive capitalism.
